title: Two Reminders about AI | Hacker News
excerpt: A model in an idle state will do nothing unless prompted by a user or researcher.

Two Reminders about AI
1 point by slackfan 20 hours ago | hide | past | favorite | 8 comments

A model in an idle state will do nothing unless prompted by a user or researcher.

Air-gapped systems do not have physical network access to the outside world.
